description: List BGS OGC API Features collections with verified OGL commercial reuse terms (borehole index and geology 625k). Other collections are excluded pending licence checks. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.
